title: The live management page: work items and bulk edit (v1)

steps.path: The live page, as it opens
steps.headline: The real page: all 143 work items, read from the files, in the approved row look.
steps.changed: Agentic buildout is open at the top; Planning (108), Preliminary exploration (28) and Merged are folded below. Each row: tick box, number, name, priority (P1 tinted red), then its tags, target release and what it needs.
steps.notice: It is a small local page started by one command, like the review decks; it reads cards/ every time it loads.
steps.risk: Human polish & review is missing because no item is in that stage yet: the move put everything into Planning, Exploring or Agentic buildout.

steps.headline: Click an item: the same centred popup, with everything on it.
steps.changed: Name, stage, priority and tags on top; its full text; what it needs, what needs it and what it overlaps, each clickable; its branch name.
steps.notice: "Tick this item" in the popup adds it to the ticked set.
steps.risk: The text is the old roadmap's wording, so it reads as raw notes for now.

steps.headline: Tick items and a bar appears with the three bulk actions.
steps.changed: "3 ticked · Move to stage… · Combine into one… · Delete… · ✕". Each group heading also has "tick all". Ticks survive searching and switching tags.
steps.notice: Combine needs two or more ticked.

steps.headline: Move to stage: pick one of the four, each with what it means.
steps.changed: Merged is not offered: an item becomes Merged when its branch merges. If a move would break a rule (two overlapping Planning items), nothing changes and the page says which rule.
steps.notice: Every change is committed and pushed straight away; the toast says "Saved and backed up."

steps.headline: Combine: pick which one survives, optionally rename it.
steps.changed: The survivor keeps its number and branch name. The others' text is folded in under "Merged in #n", their tags and links are kept, the most advanced stage and most urgent priority win, and anything pointing at them now points at the survivor.
steps.notice: It picks the most advanced one as the survivor by default.

steps.headline: Search and tag filter narrow every group at once.
steps.changed: Typing searches names, tags and text; a search opens the folded groups so matches are visible.
steps.notice: The tag box lists every tag in use.

steps.headline: At phone width the rows stack and the bar wraps under them.
steps.changed: Same page, one column; the bulk bar spans the width.
steps.notice: The item count hides at this width so it doesn't cover the title.
steps.risk: It runs on your computer, so a phone can only reach it the way it reaches review decks.
